name: VolunteerProjectCta - Own Link And Fallback
description: Both branches of the call-to-action together. Top: a project with its own sign-up link, labelled Get involved. Bottom: a project with none, falling back to the site-wide Volunteer with us CTA — the branch that keeps a project posted before its form exists from ending with no way in. The third branch, neither link, renders nothing and so has no pixels to show.
